title: Stop hook blocks the turn when the run waits at ship for a user decision
body: What happened: at the ship step I stopped on purpose to ask the user whether to merge (the project how-to needs a status commit that would rerun the gates). The stop hook then blocked my turn twice with: PG-330 is at ship and needs you. Run: warden next. Expected: the hook lets the turn end when the agent is waiting for a user answer, or warden offers a way to mark that wait (a waiting status). Steps: reach the ship step, end the turn with a question to the user. Evidence: Stop hook blocking error: warden: PG-330 is at ship and needs you. Run: warden next (or warden wait while a gate runs).
